publisher: Oxford University Press on behalf of the University of Manchester
citation: Hunter, Erica C. D. ‘Combat and Conflict in Incantation Bowls: Studies on Two Aramaic Specimens from Nippur.’ In Studia Aramaica: New Sources and New Approaches, edited by M. J. Geller, J. notes: Bibliographic details checked against the Comprehensive Aramaic Lexicon bibliography and Indiana University Libraries IUCAT contents record. The chapter itself is not held. Hunter 1994 p. 605 n. 4 and Hunter 2021 p. 138 and n. 18 identify the treated Nippur bowls as 18N18 and 18N98; Hunter 1994 distinguishes 18N20 as later. Hunter 2021's bibliography gives pp. 61–77, whereas CAL and IUCAT give 61–75; the exact terminal page awaits the volume.
